MRI Safety Information
The Umbra Vena Cava Filter is MR Conditional. Patients with this device can be scanned at 1.5-Tesla and 3-Tesla when all of the following conditions are met.
General conditions:
- Scan in First Level Controlled Operating Mode.
1.5 T scanning conditions:
- maximum B1+rms of 2.4 µT; when B1+rms is not displayed, use a whole body SAR of 2 W/kg or less.
3 T scanning conditions:
- B1+rms must not exceed 2 microtesla.
- Whole-Body SAR ≤ 4 W/kg.
- No more than 10 minutes of active scan time per session.
- Wait 60 minutes before the next imaging session.
